pwa.bannerSubtitle: Install the app on your device for faster standalone access and real-time alerts
pwa.modalTitle: Install Nile Nexus App on Your Device
pwa.modalSubtitle: Runs as a standalone desktop and mobile app on Android, iOS, and Windows 🚀
pwa.directInstallBtn: Install App Directly on This Device 🚀
pwa.winStep1Desc: Click the install icon (⊞ or ⊕) located in the address bar next to the URL.
pwa.winStep2Desc: Click the three dots at the top corner and select 'Install Nile Nexus Sales' (Install App).
pwa.winStep3Desc: Click 'Install' to run the app in its own standalone window with desktop and Start menu shortcuts!
pwa.androidStep1Desc: Tap the three dots in the top corner of your Chrome browser.
pwa.androidStep2Desc: Tap 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen' from the menu.
pwa.androidStep3Desc: Tap 'Install' and the app icon will appear among your phone's apps!
pwa.iosSubtitle: Follow these simple steps to install Nile Nexus on your home screen:
pwa.iosStep1Desc: Tap the Share icon (⎋) at the bottom of your Safari browser bar.
pwa.iosStep2Desc: Scroll down the share sheet and tap 'Add to Home Screen' (⊞).
pwa.iosStep3Desc: Tap 'Add' in the top right corner to run the app as a standalone application.
